title: Hen party boat party experience!
text:
I booked a 3 hour boat experience direct through ketch, for 18 girls to celebrate a hen party and the company did not disappoint!! 
Ketch made the experience one to remember for the bride! It wasn't great weather wise so we couldn't go out to sea as it was too rough so we just stayed in the harbour, doing loops, past bars, restaurants and seeing different sights. But with the music playing and the drinks flowing, everyone has the most amazing time! 
I had pre ordered 3 bottles of prosecco so we had these as welcome drinks as soon as we arrived before we set sail. Which was a lovely touch.

title: Fun and relaxing trip
text: Excellent service and good communication from the team. The boat was more spacious than I expected so it was very comfortable for everyone. Highly recommended this activity for anyone looking for a fun and relaxing day on the water in Barcelona!
author: salem_h

title: Really enjoyed
text: I really enjoyed the trip. The views were stunning, and the crew made the whole experience fun and relaxing. Highly recommend!
author: Andreea_V

title: Lovely experience
text: I had an unforgettable experience on the sailing tour. The staff were exceptionally friendly, providing all the necessary information and ensuring we made the most of the trip. I opted for the tapas and cava service, which proved to be an excellent choice, offering great value for both the price and the quality.
author: andreeavolocaru

title: Truly special!
text:
Definitely recommend! The boat is very spacious and we were told by the crew that it’s been around the world 2 times which made the trip feel much more special. Both the skipper and helper were very kind giving us information about the city and mentioning all the landmarks we could see from the water. 
We also purchased tapas and cava which were delicious. Top service ,will definitely come back!
author: Natalia_S

title: Amazing experience!
text: We seriously loved the trip! The skipper was very nice giving us information about the city and gave us sailing tips! The helper was very kind ,offered us tapas and cava as well as some facts and recommendations about the city. Totally recommend!!
author: Maria_P

title: Lovely boat!
text: Great host, beautiful sailboat. Our family (2 adults, 2 tens) had a great time. Host checked in earlier in day via WhatsApp so we had a contact to reach out to when there was confusion finding the boat location. Highly recommend.
